For zero circulation, the one-reciprocal-pair and path-of-two-reciprocal-pairs cases reduce to alternating cycles and binary excursion necklaces; for nonzero circulation, the single reverse-pair case similarly reduces to two excursion types. Three-pair or multiple-reverse-pair profiles admit nonconjugate Euler tours. These establish the all-length h/u/t criterion. Direct expansion of five rational GF pieces yields coefficients (n=2..12) 3,2,6,6,11,6,15,8,9,12,11; source verify.py tests all loop-free words to n=10 and balanced directed profiles to n=29. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, the constructive classification.
